# So Sketchy

> Landing page for So Sketchy, an iMessage game.

## About

So Sketchy is an async draw-and-guess game for iMessage, distributed on the App
Store.

## Policy

The site serves a landing page, a privacy policy at /privacy, and a support page
at /support. Scraping the paths under /g is disallowed. Those URLs carry
per-message state and should not be indexed.
